({async answerCall(){try{try{await g()}catch{}await window.api.post(qe("/telephone/answer")),"call"===this.$route?.name&&"phone"===this.$route?.query?.tab||await this.$router.push({name:"call",query:{tab:"phone"}})}catch{xe.error(this.$t("call.failed_to_answer_call"))}},async hangupCall(){try{this.$emit("hangup"),await window.api.post(qe("/telephone/hangup"))}catch{xe.error(this.$t("call.failed_to_hangup_call"))}},async toggleMicrophone(){try{const e=this.localMicMuted;this.isMicMuting=!0,this.localMicMuted=!e,this.$emit("toggle-mic",!e);const t=qe(e?"/telephone/unmute-transmit":"/telephone/mute-transmit");await window.api.post(t),setTimeout(()=>{this.isMicMuting=!1},500)}catch{this.isMicMuting=!1,this.localMicMuted=!this.localMicMuted,xe.error(this.$t("call.failed_to_toggle_microphone"))}},async toggleSpeaker(){try{const e=this.localSpeakerMuted;this.isSpeakerMuting=!0,this.localSpeakerMuted=!e,this.$emit("toggle-speaker",!e);const t=qe(e?"/telephone/unmute-receive":"/telephone/mute-receive");await window.api.post(t),setTimeout(()=>{this.isSpeakerMuting=!1},500)}catch{this.isSpeakerMuting=!1,this.localSpeakerMuted=!this.localSpeakerMuted,xe.error(this.$t("call.failed_to_toggle_speaker"))}},async toggleDuplexMode(){if(!this.activeCall||6!==this.activeCall.status)return;const e=this.localHalfDuplex?1:2;try{const t=await window.api.post(qe(`/telephone/switch-call-mode/${e}`));this.localPttActive=Boolean(t.data?.is_ptt_active),this.localHalfDuplex=Boolean(t.data?.is_half_duplex)}catch{xe.error(this.$t("call.failed_to_switch_call_mode"))}},async setPttActive(e){if((!this.activeCall||6!==this.activeCall.status||!this.localHalfDuplex)&&e)return;const t=Boolean(e);if(this.localPttActive!==t){this.localPttActive=t;try{await window.api.post(qe("/telephone/ptt"),{active:t})}catch{this.localPttActive=!t,t&&xe.error(this.$t("call.failed_to_set_ptt"))}}}})
